notes.title: Workshop Only Test Demo is Released [Looking for Feedback]
notes.notes:
[b]This is not full game or full demo release. This demo includes only robot workshop (editor), no testing or playing against opponents functionality.[/b]

PitBots - Workshop Only Test Demo is now available at:
[url=https://wolferion.itch.io/pitbots-demo1]https://wolferion.itch.io/pitbots-demo1[/url] (no registration needed)

Bots saved in this demo will be compatible with full game version.
(Saves, logs, crash reports are located at: %LOCALAPPDATA%\MachineCombat\Saved ).

Please use [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1474060/discussions/1/]Steam Forums[/url] to report bugs, post feedback & suggestions.

There are no restrictions for making public videos.
